brief:
Israeli occupation forces maintained closures across most military checkpoints and iron gates surrounding Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate Friday, cutting off movement for large numbers of residents in surrounding villages and towns, Shehab Wire reported.

The closure coincided with ongoing search and arrest operations across the area. Israeli forces have intensified such restrictions and raids in recent periods, further restricting Palestinian movement and access between communities in the West Bank.
